svg.title: How Hermes Tool Router works, with and without a classifier model
svg.desc: The first user turn is routed either by local deterministic rules only (the default: no API key, no network) or with an optional small classifier model for turns the rules cannot place. A confidence gate sends a narrowed tool list (likely toolsets, request_toolset with a capability catalog, and Hermes tool search) to the main model; anything uncertain keeps the full tool list. Missing tools are added permanently for the session through automatic middleware, Hermes tool search, or the request_toolset fallback. /router off turns routing off without a model call. By AtlasOmnia.
svg.text: Shrink the first provider request when confidence is high. Keep every tool when it is not.
